actual_hours.description: Labour hours actually charged to the project at assessment time.

budget_hours.description: Tendered labour hours the actual is measured against (parsed schedule total or override).

elapsed_pct.description: Fraction of project duration elapsed at assessment time.

project_ref.description: The Demiton project the verdict is about (the `project_code` the writer keys on).

run_rate_pct.description: `burn_pct / elapsed_pct` — headcount run-rate against expected pace; the value the verdict thresholds are applied to.

source_file.description: Name of the resource-schedule workbook the budget side came from.

source_uri.description: Canonical URI of the verdict fact (`demiton://project/{code}/overstaffing-verdict`).

verdict.description: The outcome: `OVERSTAFFED`, `ON_TRACK` or `UNDERSTAFFED`. `BUDGET_ONLY` is *not* a stored value — the writer returns without writing.

verdict_thresholds.description: The `overstaffed_at` / `understaffed_at` cut-offs used for this assessment.

standards.title: Human resource management - Requirements and recommendations for human capital reporting and disclosure
